Figure 4:Application coverage and task–file reference families. Application counts
measure multi-label application–task incidences. The 17,542
InfiniteWeb[19]tasks are reported separately. File-family shares
are computed over 877,608 references.

Figure 5:Rollout-as-a-Service architecture for asynchronous desktop RL. The
resource manager coordinates task dispatch, sandbox scheduling, and compact
episode storage. Runners handle environment interaction, harness execution,
trajectory construction, and evaluation. The relay separates control,
inference, and trajectory traffic; model weights synchronize within the GPU
cluster. The diagram shows a 24-training/8-inference-GPU deployment.
